 New ALIEN Film Has a Screenwriter, Not a ROMULUS Sequel
 by Eric Diaz 
 Oct 23 2026 • 4:00 PM 
 Add us on 
 Quick Take 
 Twentieth Century Studios has commissioned a script by Raised By Wolves creator Aaron Guzikowski for a new Alien film, with original Alien director Ridley Scott producing.
 This new film will connect to Scott’s previous entries in the franchise, Prometheus and Alien: Covenant . It will not be a sequel to Alien: Romulus , which came out in 2024.
 Michael Fassbender is not attached currently, although his characters, the androids David and Walter, were a big part of the last two Scott films set in this universe.
 Nerdist’s take: We hope that Scott’s new film doesn’t cancel the Romulus sequel, which we are honestly more excited about. There is room in the Alien timeline for all kinds of stories.
 Ridley Scott is returning to the world he created in 1979 , as the esteemed director is coming back to the world of Alien. Although this time, it seems the 89-year-old Scott will only be producing, not directing. According to The Hollywood Reporter , screenwriter Aaron Guzikowski, who wrote Denis Villeneuve’s Prisoners , will write the screenplay for a new Alien project for 20th Century Studios. Guzikowski worked with Ridley Scott before, as he created the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves , which Scott directed the first two episodes of. This will connect to Scott’s last two Alien -verse features, 2012’s Prometheus and 2017’s Alien: Covenant. 
 20th Century Studios What seems most interesting is that this is not a sequel to, or connected to, the much-liked Alien: Romulus . Originally meant to be a straight-to-streaming film, Romulus was released to much critical and commercial success. Far more than Covenant , which put the franchise on ice for several years. Twentieth Century Studios announced a sequel for Romulus , but we’ve heard nothing about it for some time now. It’s quite possible this new Alien film is effectively replacing it. This also doesn’t seem to conflict with Alien: Earth on Hulu in any way, which is currently shooting its second season. 
 Nerdist’s Take: We Hope There’s Room for Scott’s Alien film, and a Proper Sequel to Alien: Romulus 
 The connective tissue between Prometheus and Covenant is the android character David, played by Michael Fassbender. The report says he’s not currently attached. However, he seems to be the one character who needs to come back. Covenant ended on a rather grim cliffhanger involving David, which they have not addressed again in ten years. Could this new film finally reveal what happened to him? And would it finally connect Ridley Scott’s last two films to the original Alien ? Hopefully, loyal xenomorph fans can get this film and a follow-up to Romulus at some point. There’s room in the Alien timeline for all of these stories to take place.
 Eric Diaz is a staff writer at Nerdist and a Swiss Army knife of fandoms. Eric loves DC, Marvel, horror movies, and even Star Wars and Star Trek equally.
